notes.title: An announcement about the Inner Mirror update
notes.notes:
Hello Gunners,

The [b]Inner Mirror[/b] update that was scheduled for today has unfortunately been pushed back by about two weeks. 
We apologize for the disappointment for those of you who have been waiting for this update. The actual development time required was greater than we had anticipated, and we'll need about two more weeks of development than we had promised. We're behind schedule, but we'll make up for it by delivering a more polished product. And to make sure you don't get bored during the two-week wait, we wanted to give you a sneak peek at what we're working on for the next update with this announcement.

[h2]Inner Mirror[/h2]
The [b]Inner Mirror[/b] is a small, gold-trimmed mirror in one corner of the inn. The character looking into the mirror is confronted with his own face, as Toby says, "I see myself turning into a monster." But when he looks deeper into that face... a hidden inner self is revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722010/9e4965b697962ebf271be8c9f22d48e719c2a433.png[/img]

[i]When you stare into the abyss, the abyss stares back at you - Nietzsche - [/i]

[h3]Origins of Skills[/h3]
Beyond your demonized face, your character's potential shimmers. Face your true self and embrace it.
You can tap into your character's previous memories and revive skills from their human days. Or you can adapt to your changing form and harness its brutal, merciless power. It's up to you to decide which abilities to use to strengthen your character.

[h3]Make strategic choices[/h3]
Higher-cost skills have more powerful effects, but sometimes two lower-cost skills can be more powerful. Try to buy skills strategically so that they synergize with each other. You can reset equipped Skills at any time to try different strategies.

[h3]Earning Potential Points[/h3]
At first, you may not have enough Potential Points to equip expensive skills or unlock locked slots, but don't let that stop you from tackling the dungeon again! Potential Points are earned by leveling up and surviving more intense fires.


[h2]Story Cartoon[/h2]
We want to tell the story of the game's world and its main character, Toby, through a webcomic. The story webcomic is currently fully drawn, but the translation and skip functionality is not yet implemented. We'd love to get the webcomic into the game as soon as possible, but it's taking priority over Mirror, so we're delaying it a bit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722010/21cea33465c0d89dbcaaf0c072868ecda5f14e54.png[/img]


[h2]Added Inn NPCs[/h2]
A new group of guests has joined the Inn. These four distinctive-looking individuals have presumably fallen victim to a demonic "wish gun" like Toby. Introducing themselves as being from the "Tumblebuck Patron Clan," these half-humans are expected to make the Inn a little more lively, although they don't interact much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722010/bd7164af03b51dc2700b85468104ec7b50f1c88b.png[/img]

[h2]Next Update Announcement[/h2]
The [u][b]next update[/b][/u] is expected on February 15th, Pacific Time, and will include an update to the 'Inner Mirror', a new skill puck system.

[h3]Beta Test[/h3]
Starting February 7, you'll be able to preview the next update with a beta test. Not all features will be implemented, but you'll be able to try out the Skill Puck. Previously, we've only given beta access to Tumble Buck backers, but we'll also be giving it to some streamers who have been active on our official Discord channel. [url=https://discord.gg/Zw2pndhW]Pixel Gunmaster Discord[/url]

※ Please note that beta testing privileges are awarded by us, not by you. You do not need to apply via email.

[h3]Reset Progress[/h3]
[u][b]Attention![/b][/u] In the next update, your game progress will be [u][b]reset[/b][/u]. This is necessary in order to implement the new system, so we ask for your understanding. Elements that will be reset include your level, experience, fire and brimstone stages, and dialog progress.

[h3]So when is the next stage coming out?[/h3]
We know that many of you are waiting for the next stage update. We'll be working on the next priority, "Region 2 Ice Cave," right after this update, so stay tuned for that.

notes.title: Early Access Patch 006 -- v0.1.7
notes.notes:
Hello Gunners,

In [u][b]this patch[/b][/u], we've added the much-anticipated skill system "Inner Mirror" and story comics. This update took longer than planned due to an unexpected bug, and we thank you for your patience and anticipation. Also, as previously announced, your game progress has been reset. Please go back to the beginning and enjoy the upgraded Pixel Gun Master.

The [u][b]next update[/b][/u] will include a balance patch, fixing old bugs, adding a second region, and adding a Russian translation. These updates may be all at once, or one after the other, so we'll keep you posted on the schedule.

[h1]- Patch Notes -[/h1]
[h3][Content][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the Inner Mirror system, which can be accessed by interacting with the mirrors in the Inn.
     Equip the skill of your choice from the Inner Mirror and gain powerful effects.
[*] Added a "Balance" system that changes your character's appearance based on the skills you equip.
     Revive your character's human form, or unleash their demonic powers to take on a new look.
[*] Hover your mouse over the 'i' button in the inner mirror for a detailed explanation.
[*] A story comic has been added that plays at the start of the game. Check out the story of the main character, Toby.
[*] The starting coins you earn when leveling up have been replaced with Potential Points.
[/list]

[h3][Graphics][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added effects for the Inner Mirror skills.
[*] Added 6 new character appearances based on balance effects.
[*] The main character's death effect has been changed.
[*] Added animations for each character.
[*] Added 4 Patron NPCs to the Inn lobby.
[*] Added animations for 4 Patron NPCs.
[/list]

[h3][UI][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the Inner Mirror UI.
[*] Added ability to use the esc shortcut to exit from the Inner Mirror UI.
[*] Added fire intensity tiers to the pause screen.
[*] The Pause screen now displays your equipped skills.
[*] Added Heat experience bonuses to the Game Over screen.
[*] The gameover screen now shows potential points when leveling up.
[*] Added Heat level to the gameover screen.
[*] Added damage taken to the game over screen.
[/list]


[h3][Balancing][/h3]
[list]
[*] Compared to the beta, skill balance has been adjusted across the board.
[*] The reload speed of the 'Battle Decoration' part has been reduced from 60 ->40. 
[*] The maximum level has been adjusted from 40 ->30.
[/list]


[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Gunflower's seed shooting sound would continue on the game over screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from being re-challenged in game.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented skills from being applied in the lobby.
[*] Intimidating Roar skill damage reduction has been applied.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game results screen would freeze while sliding.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Piety skill would heal above max health.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ample Space skill would continue to work after being removed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Courage skill would become uncontrollable for 0.1 seconds after dashing when equipped.
[*] Fixed a bug where the hand holding the gun was incorrectly positioned.
[/list]

P.S. The Patron NPC's dialog will be added in the next update.

notes.title: Early Access Patch 002 -- v0.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello Gunners,

In [u][b]this patch[/b][/u], we've delivered on the planned difficulty increase for the Golem boss - expect a tighter map, stronger patterns, and a more frantic boss fight. We've also made a number of usability patches - we've added a number of features that should help you in areas where you may have felt frustrated, and we've designed the game to be more intuitive and have stronger feedback.

The [u][b]next update[/b][/u] is December 7th and includes the Fire and Brimstone system (Ascetic difficulty), boss fight cutscenes, and dash cooldown markers.

During the week, we received a large amount of bug reports and feedback via [url=https://discord.gg/RARKzV7J]Discord[/url]. With your help, we were able to quickly identify improvements and incorporate them into this patch. Thank you, Gunners, for always caring and playing the game!ːsteamhappyː

[h1]- Patch Notes -[/h1]
[h3][Content Additions][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Golem boss has been reworked to a higher difficulty.
[*] The old shockwave (white circle) pattern was felt to be too easy and didn't add much to the boss fight, so it has been replaced with a new pattern.
[*] Reduced the size of the boss room, giving you less room to run and more time to focus on the boss.
[/list]

[h3][Graphical fix][/h3]
[list]
[*] Well water now disappears when you drink it.
[*] Fixed the shop map to reduce unnecessary traveling and make Big Deal visible at once.
[*] The E button is now larger and more visible.
[*] When chests containing items are frozen, the image has been modified to distinguish them from other monsters.
[*] Added player death motion.
[*] Added Big Deal's smiling reaction when purchasing his items.
[*] Added an image of boxes gradually crumbling when their health is low.
[*] Changed so that the main character is not blocked by the bar table in the inn.
[/list]

[h3][UI Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] The camera has been zoomed out so that there is more visible space on the stage.
18 tiles horizontally -> 20 tiles vertically
[*] Removed the Refresh and Earn Gold buttons from the gun parts acquisition window on stage 1-1.
[*] Added an exclamation mark to indicate when an NPC's dialog has changed.
[*] Reduced the length of the soundbar in the settings.
[*] Fixed the remaining stage time shown in the top bar to look the same as the actual time remaining.
[*] Effect descriptions now appear above the main character's head when using items (so now you know what the hand mirror does!)
[*] Added a Q button under the items in your inventory UI.
[/list]

[h3][Balancing][/h3]
[list]
[*] We've increased monster spawn times to give you more time to react to monsters spawning under your feet.
1 second spawn time -> 1.5 seconds
[*] Added a 0.3 second wait between the boss's pattern and the pattern.
[/list]

[h3][Bug fix][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where previous conversation text was briefly visible when starting a conversation.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze while talking to a shopkeeper.
[*] Fixed a bug where the protagonist would still move when interacting with the E button (Toby should be a little calmer when talking to you now).
[*] Fixed a bug where fireworks were dealing 1 damage.
[*] Fixed a bug where the reload bar would get stuck and not reload.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause extremely long reload times.
[*] Fixed a bug where cylinder magazines would not consume ammo based on critical hit chance when equipped.
[*] Fixed a bug where entering a shop twice in the same attempt would cause the game to freeze without talking to the merchant.
[*] Fixed a bug where bosses would only use a continuous dash pattern in phase 2.
[*] Fixed a bug where using the full freeze item while equipped with the ice cream grip would cause the game to bounce.
[*] 
[/list]
[h3][Misc][/h3]
[list]
[*] There is currently a bug where monsters spawn where they shouldn't. A hotfix will be applied as soon as we're done fixing that bug.
[/list]

notes.title: Pixel Gun Master Roadmap Update - November 2023
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Gunners[/h2].

The future roadmap for Pixel Gun Master has been revealed!

We will be releasing updates every 2-4 weeks until all content is updated.
Updates will include new features, more stages, usability improvements, new characters, and more.

[h3]Goals for the roadmap[/h3]

Some of you who have played the game right now have no doubt expressed your frustration with the lack of content, and we know that the lack of objectives after beating the current bosses can turn people off quickly, so we're prioritizing content expansion to keep you coming back for more.

There are tons of features that we haven't even scratched the surface of yet, which you can see in our roadmap below. We're confident that with each new feature on the roadmap, we'll be able to address some of your frustrations and add some new fun that will motivate you to tackle dungeons again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722010/e0d35095df68c1b71fed054362d35d9522e189b0.jpg[/img]

Let's take a look at the features on the roadmap one by one.

[h3]Coming Soon[/h3]

Coming Soon is dominated by items to fill in gaps in content.
[list]
[*] We're adding a skill puck system that you can choose from when you level up.
[*] We'll be adding harder difficulties for more powerful protagonists.
[*] New stages will be added to introduce new enemies and bosses.
[/list]

We're also adding support for custom keystrokes and controller compatibility for those of you who were bored with the old ones. Now you can right-click and dash, or use your controller to explore the dungeon from your couch.
We'll also be improving various graphical and sound effects. The list is long, so we'll be covering them in the patch notes.

A lot of the content in Coming Soon will be fully developed in the next 2-3 months, most notably the skill puck system and the new difficulty system, which will be available by December.

[h3]In Development[/h3]

In Development is a collection of elements that will be added in the long term.
[list]
[*] New Stages
[*] New NPCs
[*] New gun parts
[*] New Heroes
[*] New Ambassadors
[*] A book that reveals the secrets of the game
[*] etc.
[/list]

We'll be adding cutscenes to make the main story easier to understand, so that you can tell an interesting story. You'll also be able to discover new NPCs and solve cases by interacting with new innkeepers. As you progress through the story, new elements will be unlocked one by one.

[h3]In Concept[/h3]

In Concept contains the elements we envisioned. These are the things that we thought, "What if we added this content? Wouldn't this system be more fun? These are experimental elements that we'll take the time to develop. Maybe they'll be added after launch, but no matter how long it takes, we're not going to give up on the things that make the game more fun.

[h3]Word of Thanks[/h3]

We're still a small studio of six people, so updates may take a while. However, we're not giving up and we're going to keep working on the game to bring you the kind of fun we envisioned while developing Pixel Gun Master for a year. If you're having fun with the game, too, let us know. We'll be listening to your comments and advice on Twitter, Discord, and the Steam community.

To all of our Tumblebuck backers, our attendees at G-Star, and our current new players, thank you for supporting Pixel Gun Master and having fun with it! We'll be back in the coming weeks with something new, so thank you again.
